recent154: Does Verfiai tell me what is true?
recent155: No. Verfiai provides verification support by surfacing available evidence. It does not make definitive truth judgments. Review the sources and apply your own judgment.
recent157: The sources found are ambiguous, conflicting or too thin to clearly support or contradict the claim, so it needs manual review. It isn't a judgement that the claim is false.
recent159: It reflects the strength of the available evidence — source quality, diversity, recency and whether the AI engines agreed. It is not a guarantee of truth.
recent161: No. It can only evaluate publicly accessible content. Paywalled or offline sources cannot be read.
recent162: How does Verfiai handle conflicting evidence?
recent163: Two AI engines review the same retrieved excerpts. If they materially disagree, a third engine reviews the conflicting evidence, and conflicting excerpts are shown side by side. AI agreement is one input to confidence, not proof of accuracy.
